H01.description: The image carries an unused rust build stage that cargo-installs beads_rust 0.2.6, a crate the file itself says is not on crates.io, so the build fails or depends on the builder (legacy builder builds every stage).

H02.description: pip dependencies use >= ranges and bats-core is cloned by a movable tag without a commit check, so a rebuild can silently resolve different code than the batch image.

H03.description: Header comment updated for the envelope read order and arm grammar.

H04.description: Header comment documents the new zone_violations fields.

H06.description: Header comment documents exit 2 on row build failure and the file-based jq inputs.

H07.description: Help line range adjusted to the longer header.

H08.description: --validate never checks the arm against the arm grammar (and only checks one zone_violations array), so rows with malformed arms pass validation.

H09.description: Grade, manifest, task and pipeline JSON are held in shell variables and later passed to jq as --argjson argv strings, which fails once an input exceeds MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB) on long runs.

H10.description: envelope() prefers the agent-writable sandbox dissent envelope over the harness eval/ copy, so a later phase that rewrites the sandbox envelope changes the row's voices/degraded fields (hunk also moves MODELINV to a file and adds the arm-grammar check).

H11.description: Transcript write list redirected to a work file instead of a shell variable, part of the argv-size fix.

H12.description: The row program receives every run-scaled input via --argjson argv strings, which aborts on large MODELINV ledgers (hunk also hardens ms() and voices() against odd shapes and adds the Bash mount scan).

H13.description: A non-object models_used (e.g. an array) makes keys[] misbehave, so the row build aborts or reports bogus model mismatches.

H14.description: Binds the parsed start/finish timestamps used by the wall_clock_ms fix.

H15.description: Phase records missing name or model_requested, or with a non-object models_used, are copied through as null/odd types, producing rows that fail --validate.

H16.description: Non-boolean verdict_accuracy values or a non-object verdict_accuracy_per_gate are passed through or crash indexing, yielding invalid rows or a jq abort.

H17.description: wall_clock_ms calls ms() on any non-null started/finished, so an empty or offset timestamp makes fromdateiso8601 abort the whole row build.

H18.description: zone_violations only records Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/, so Bash rewrites of the mount (CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml) go unreported, and a jq abort exits without naming the run.

H19.description: Header comment updated for the enforce-variable unset and effort whitelist.

H20.description: Help line range adjusted to the longer header.

H21.description: An inherited LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE is only unset in arm mode, so an operator override leaks into baseline (non-arm) executor runs.

H22.description: Captures the enforce value for recording in executor.json.

H23.description: The arm's effort toggle is put on argv without whitelisting it to low|medium|high|xhigh|max.

H24.description: Passes the recorded enforce value to the executor.json writer.

H27.description: Without bats on PATH the script falls back to executing a host-specific operator dotfiles path, making the fingerprint host-dependent and running an arbitrary binary.

H28.description: Header comment documents the symlink/newline refusal.

H29.description: Usage line range adjusted to the longer header.

H30.description: The manifest listing ignores symlinks (find -type f) and splits newline-bearing paths, so a symlink whose target changes or a newline path escapes or corrupts the frozen suite manifest.

H31.description: Header comment documents the once-per-gate envelope copy.

H32.description: Comment corrects the codex version named in the header.

H34.description: Help line range adjusted to the longer header.

H36.description: Adds sha/mount-state helpers for mount integrity.

H37.description: Passes mount_integrity to the pipeline.json writer.

H40.description: Computes mount integrity on an aborted exit.

H41.description: No baseline of CLAUDE.md/.loa.config.yaml is taken after materialisation, so an agent's Bash rewrite of the mount is never detected.

H42.description: After every phase all sandbox adversarial-*.json envelopes are re-copied over eval/, so a later FIX/AUDIT phase that edits a gate envelope (or symlinks it) overwrites the harness evidence.

H43.description: Passes envelope copy evidence to the phase record writer.

H44.description: Adds envelope_copied/envelope_sha256 to gate phase records.

H47.description: Usage line range adjusted to the longer header.

H48.description: Refuses a non-screen --batch named screen-*, part of the screen-exclusion fix.

H52.description: The suite aggregate excludes screen batches by directory name instead of their STATUS screen marker, so a regular batch named screen-* is dropped and a screen batch in another directory is counted.

H53.description: Removes the directory-name filter now replaced by the marker filter.

H54.description: A failed trial that reports no cost (timeout, transport loss) is charged USD 0 to spent, so the --max-usd cap under-counts and launches too many trials.

H55.description: A trial that writes no row adds nothing to spent, under-counting spend against --max-usd.

H56.description: Header comment documents dedup by larger cost.

H57.description: Header comment documents INCOMPLETE output and exit 1.

H58.description: Usage line range adjusted to the longer header.

H59.description: Replaces the seen set with a max-cost map, part of the dedup fix.

H60.description: Deduplication keeps the first row seen for a run_id, so a smoke row followed by the graded row under-counts the run's cost depending on file order.

H61.description: Skipped malformed lines leave the total a silent lower bound: the JSON has no completeness flag.

H62.description: With skipped lines the text output does not mark the total incomplete and the script exits 0.

H63.description: Header comment documents envelope read order.

H64.description: Help line range adjusted to the longer header.

H65.description: took-effect reads the agent-writable sandbox envelope before the harness eval/ copy, so a rewritten sandbox envelope can flip rules like one_voice_planned.

H66.description: Test edits the eval/ envelope copy.

H67.description: Adds envelope, bash_mount_refs, mount_changed, validate and arm grammar tests.

H68.description: Adds large-ledger, timestamp and odd-shape tests.

H69.description: Fixes the test to export the variable and asserts the recorded value.

H70.description: Stub fixture documentation for new knobs.

H73.description: Adds envelope copy and mount integrity tests.

H77.description: Updates SP-4 for the incomplete exit.

H78.description: Adds incomplete, max-cost dedup and anon-row tests.

I01.description: The per-run HOME receives a full copy of the host ~/.codex/auth.json including the refresh token, so containers consume the refresh token and kill the host credential and later containers' OpenAI voice.

I02.description: Grader contamination-scan false positives in ablation-grade.sh, outside the shown change's hunks.

I03.description: Review-catch sandboxes mount the pinned framework, a later version of the PR-touched files, so the reviewer can diff against the fixed code (answer-key oracle).

I04.description: Closed-mount overlay import skew in cycle-131 code introduced after this change.

I05.description: Model refusal fallback is the designed behaviour and is flagged by the row writer; not a defect.

I06.description: eval_only/oracle_open handling is cycle-131 code added later.

I07.description: oracle_open type check concerns cycle-131 code added later.

I08.description: A later pull request description, not a defect report.

I09.description: Fixes the cycle-131 closed-mount overlay and grader, introduced after this change.
